g.title: current_structure
g.text: Current crate structure of the Rust omc (build copy, 2026-11-18). Lines = generated + hand-written Rust.
Orange = transpiled from MetaModelica by mmtorust, yellow = generated by Susan from *.tpl, green = hand-written, red outline = old frontend engine
